correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the two maximal clique types (star from a (k-1)-set, top inside a (k+1)-set); every simplex with at least three vertices belongs to exactly one. The previously published full nonequivariant all-parameter collapse and hypersimplex 2-skeleton proof establishes H2 concentration and simple connectivity. Oriented edge stabilizers exchange endpoints with sign, giving h_(k-1)e2 h_(n-k-1). Each star/top simplex above dimension 1 contributes wedge^2 of its augmentation representation to the Euler class. Their induction yields the five-term Frobenius characteristic displayed in RESULT.md; applying e2 h_b=s_(b,1,1)+s_(b+1,1) and the three horizontal-strip Pieri identities cancels all non-four-row summands exactly. Complementation is S_n-equivariant. Independent hook-length dimensions agree at (6,3)=19,(7,3)=55,(8,4)=181. Finite code cannot replace the all-parameter Pieri argument.
